label: Early original-phase position (3rd/4th input), token-modulated
explanation: Fires almost only at original-phase steps t=2 and t=3 (the 3rd and 4th input tokens). These two steps hold 99.7% of activation mass: t=2 has 69% (rate 42%) and t=3 has 31% (rate 23%). There is a trace at t=4 and essentially nothing at t<=1, at the delimiter, or in the copy phase. Position alone gives recall 0.99 but precision 0.33. Within those positions, firing depends on the current token: highest for 1, k, n, p, f, r, m, y (rate 10-14% overall) and weak for many others. It also depends on the previous token (r, n, y, 0, h raise the rate). It is mostly suppressed when the current token repeats an earlier token (in_first=0 holds only 8% of mass). The largest activations are on 1 at t=2 after prefixes like n r, n y or n 0. The token sets are an approximation of a graded token and context dependence, so precision and recall stay around 0.65-0.7.
